finam.authentication: POST /v1/sessions with secret; bearer JWT; POST /v1/sessions/details for accounts
finam.bar_timestamp_semantics: interval start; availability is start plus one hour
finam.pagination: no request token documented; none sent

schema_authority.asset: ticker, symbol=ticker@mic, mic, id, type, is_archived, decimals, min_step, lot_size, currency, future_details.contract_size
schema_authority.decimal_json: {num: integer/string integer, scale: non-negative integer}; value=num*10^-scale
schema_authority.params: account-specific is_tradable BoolValue and trade_lot_size Decimal
schema_authority.quantity: Order quantity.value is asset units; one MOEX futures asset unit is one contract and must respect trade_lot_size
